1. Each click adds a positive point, and each Alt-click a negative point.
2. All points of this image go to the provider you chose for Click to select, with the whole image.
3. The provider's model, such as SAM 2.1 in the engine or EfficientSAM tiny in the browser, answers with a mask.
4. The mask replaces the selection. It is labeled as an AI result.
5. The points stay for this image until you clear them or change the image.
